accepted_concepts: going about from one site to another

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts constant movement into staying put
confuses travelling with the near-twin about being marginal

peripatetic.mental_hook: Named for a philosopher who taught while walking.
peripatetic.semantic_hint: The word for a music teacher who visits four schools a week.

accepted_concepts: at the edge rather than the centre

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts the marginal into the core
confuses being at the edge with the near-twin about roving

peripheral.required_nuance: at the edge, and so of lesser importance
peripheral.mental_hook: At the edge, and it matters less for that.
peripheral.semantic_hint: The word for a concern that has nothing to do with the main decision.

accepted_concepts: come to an end violently or from hardship

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts dying into enduring
guesses from a vaguely similar shape

perish.semantic_hint: What crops do in a drought, and what people do in a disaster.

accepted_concepts: swearing to what one knows is untrue
breaking a sworn oath by lying

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts a lie under oath into honest evidence
loses the deliberateness that makes it a crime

perjury.required_nuance: a deliberate lie told under oath
perjury.semantic_hint: The crime a witness commits by lying in the box.

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts spreading through into emptying
confuses spreading through with the near-twin about wandering

permeate.required_nuance: spreading through every part of something
permeate.mental_hook: Right through, not just on top.
permeate.semantic_hint: What the smell of frying does to a whole house.

accepted_concepts: destructive in a way that works unseen

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts harm into benefit
loses the subtlety that defines it

pernicious.required_nuance: harmful, and working gradually or unnoticed
pernicious.semantic_hint: The word for an idea that does damage slowly over a generation.

accepted_concepts: the concluding part of a speech
the grand summing-up at the end
the rhetorical finale of an address
the closing section delivered with force
the last and most elaborate passage

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts the conclusion into the introduction
loses the formality and grandeur that define it

peroration.required_nuance: the ending of a speech, and a grand one
peroration.semantic_hint: The word for the rousing final passage of a great speech.

accepted_concepts: be responsible for a bad act

incorrect_associations.misconception: confuses committing an act with the near-twin about prolonging
inverts committing into stopping

perpetrate.required_nuance: committing a wrong, not prolonging one
perpetrate.mental_hook: Commits it. The near-twin keeps it going.
perpetrate.semantic_hint: What someone does by committing a fraud.

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts the endless into the passing
confuses endlessness with the near-twin about committing a wrong

perpetual.semantic_hint: The word for a state of argument that never once pauses.

accepted_concepts: preserve a practice into the future
sustain so it does not end

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts prolonging into abolishing
confuses prolonging with the near-twin about committing a wrong

perpetuate.required_nuance: keeping something in existence, not committing it
perpetuate.mental_hook: Keeps it going. The near-twin commits it.
perpetuate.semantic_hint: What a textbook does to a myth by repeating it for fifty years.

accepted_concepts: a benefit attached to a position
an extra advantage of a job
a privilege that comes with the post

incorrect_associations.answer: a necessary condition to be met first
incorrect_associations.misconception: hears the sound-alike about something required in advance
confuses an extra benefit with the basic pay

perquisite.required_nuance: an extra benefit that comes with a post
perquisite.mental_hook: The extras that come with the job.
perquisite.semantic_hint: The word for a company car that comes with a senior role.

accepted_concepts: steady effort in the face of obstacles

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts persistence into quitting
confuses admirable persistence with obstinacy

perseverance.mental_hook: Keeps at it, and it is hard.
perseverance.semantic_hint: The quality that finishes a doctorate after six discouraging years.

accepted_concepts: keep on in the face of opposition

incorrect_associations.misconception: inverts continuing into stopping
hears the sound-alike about noticing

persist.required_nuance: continuing despite what would stop others
persist.semantic_hint: What a symptom does when it has not cleared after a month.
